programmes.description: Cand Harry Potter revine pentru cel de-al cincilea an la Hogwarts, toti vrajitorii cred ca intalnirea lui cu Cap-de-Mort e o minciuna. Dar uneltirile intunecatului lord ii ameninta pe studenti, asa ca Harry decide sa rezolve lucrurile.
programmes.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

programmes.description: Harry află tot mai multe despre trecutul Lordului Întunecat și devine cel mai bun elev al cursului de Poţiuni după ce descoperă un manual al unui misterios Prinţ Semipur. Ron e atras de Hermione, iar Harry e tot mai atent la sora lui Ron, Ginny.
programmes.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

programmes.description: O aventură epică in care prietenosul Om Păianjen isi va uni forțele cu Gwen Stacy și o nouă echipă de Oameni Păianjeni pentru a se confrunta cu un răufăcător mai puternic decât orice au întâlnit vreodată.
programmes.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse

programmes.description: Un actor e diagnosticat cu o boală terminală și părăsește platoul de filmare, încercând se descopere dacă poate fi curajos și în viața reală.
programmes.title: Death of a Comedian

programmes.description: Filmul oferă o privire rară asupra relației dintre iubitul autor pentru copii A. A. Milne și fiul său, Christopher Robin, ale cărui jucării au inspirat lumea magică a lui „Winnie the Pooh”.
programmes.title: Goodbye Christopher Robin

programmes.description: Brian tocmai a fost concediat de la locul de muncă. Devine un tată care stă acasă. Acceptă o invitație la joacă din partea unui alt tată care stă acasă și care se dovedește a fi o bombă cu ceas.
programmes.title: Playdate

programmes.description: Serialul urmărește conflictele din jurul familiei Russell, o familie proaspăt îmbogățită, și a vecinilor lor cu o avere acumulată în generații, familia van Rhijn, din înalta societate a New York-ului anilor 1880.
programmes.title: The Gilded Age

programmes.description: E vară în Londra. În ultima ei zi de libertate, Ziba, o adolescentă britanico-iraniană cu potențial, își conduce prietenii într-o călătorie plină de evenimente, în timp ce se luptă în secret cu o decizie care i-ar putea schimba viața.
programmes.title: Last Swim

programmes.description: The Northman, de la aclamatul regizor Robert Eggers, este o epopee despre răzbunare care ne arată până unde va merge un prinț viking pentru a răzbuna moartea tatălui său.
programmes.title: The Northman

programmes.description: După ce familia i-a fost ucisă în război, un bărbat se întoarce acasă pentru a demonta locuința cu intenția de-a o reconstrui în altă parte. Când ucigașul, un comandant al Armatei Roșii, îi dă de urmă, începe un periculos joc de-a șoarecele și pisica.
programmes.title: Sisu: Road to Revenge

programmes.description: În timp ce-şi plănuieşte noua spargere, un hoţ încearcă să-şi pună ordine în sentimentele care le are pentru un manager de bancă şi să se ferească de un agent FBI care încearcă să-l prindă cu tot cu echipa lui.
programmes.title: The Town

programmes.description: Filmul oferă o privire rară asupra relației dintre iubitul autor pentru copii A. A. Milne și fiul său, Christopher Robin, ale cărui jucării au inspirat lumea magică a lui „Winnie the Pooh”.
programmes.title: Goodbye Christopher Robin

programmes.description: Dupa imblanzirea dragonilor, Mancaul le povesteste tinerilor vikingi despre Bork cel care a scris cartea dragonilor si despre clasele de dragoni si reprezentantii lor principali, totul fiind povestit intr-o maniera foarte amuzanta.
programmes.title: Book of Dragons

programmes.description: Brian tocmai a fost concediat de la locul de muncă. Devine un tată care stă acasă. Acceptă o invitație la joacă din partea unui alt tată care stă acasă și care se dovedește a fi o bombă cu ceas.
programmes.title: Playdate

programmes.description: Harry aşteaptă în casa de pe Privet Drive sosirea prietenilor săi. Ordinul Phoenix îl va escorta într-un loc sigur, departe de ochii şi urechile Lordului Întunecat şi-ale susţinătorilor săi. Dar ce va face Harry atunci?
programmes.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part I

programmes.description: În ultimul film al francizei fenomen, conflictul dintre forţele bune şi cele malefice din lumea vrăjitorilor se transformă într-un război total. Miza n-a fost niciodată atât de mare şi nimeni nu mai este în siguranţă.
programmes.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

programmes.description: Un tanar încearcă să afle mai multe despre tatăl său, rememorând poveștile despre viața acestuia. Astfel, din istorii și fabulații, fiul începe să descopere marile calități și marile defecte ale părintelui său, care își trăiește ultimele zile.
programmes.title: Big Fish

programmes.description: John si Jennifer s-au casatorit de curand, dar nu vor sa intre prea repede in lumea responsabilitatilor familiale asa ca, in loc de un copil, au ales sa se ingrijeasca de un caine. Marley este un labrador adorabil.
programmes.title: Marley & Me

programmes.description: Victimă a unui atac brutal, Mark Hogancamp (Steve Carell) găsește un mijloc terapeutic neobișnuit în dificilul lui proces de recuperare.
programmes.title: Welcome to Marwen

programmes.description: Touch descrie călătoria unui văduv care încearcă să-și găsească prima dragoste cât încă mai are timp.
programmes.title: Touch

programmes.description: Un portret emoționant despre Never Use Alone - o linie telefonică anonimă de urgențe, condusă de voluntari care stau mereu la telefon- și despre nenumărații oameni care caută companie și speranță, sub masca dependenței.
programmes.title: Hotline

programmes.description: O fată de 17 ani este forțată să se mute cu familia ei într-o stațiune unde lucrurile nu sunt ceea ce par a fi.
programmes.title: Cuckoo

programmes.description: Primul weekend romantic al tinerilor îndrăgostiți Iris și Isaac eșuează în cel mai neașteptat mod posibil.
programmes.title: Oh, Hi!

programmes.description: Parachute spune povestea tinerei Riley, care a ieșit recent dintr-un program de reabilitare pentru tulburarea alimentară de care suferă. Fata îl va cunoaște pe Ethan și se va trezi pe linia subțire care separă dragostea de o altă dependență.
programmes.title: Parachute

programmes.description: Touch descrie călătoria unui văduv care încearcă să-și găsească prima dragoste cât încă mai are timp.
programmes.title: Touch

În fiecare săptămână, urmărind “Pe platourile de filmare”, aveți șansa de a ajunge în culisele celor mai importante producții de la Hollywood. Cu acest prilej, aveți șansa unor interviuri extraordinare cu actorii filmului și cu cei implicați în realizarea propriu-zisă a ceea ce fusese cândva un simplu proiect, iar acum a devenit o peliculă despre care toată lumea vorbește.

Dar nu ține cont cu adevărat de ce-i cere Barbara, punându-și în aplicare, în schimb, propriile idei creative – care sunt puțin cam îndrăznețe. Va reuși Miffy să găsească o modalitate de a-l face pe recenzor să-și dea seama cât de minunat este magazinul Barbarei?
programmes.title: Miffy şi prietenii ei

programmes.description: Când Miffy crede din greșeală că pomul din curtea ei este un copac care îndeplinește dorințe, ea nu vrea ca această iluzie să ia sfârșit.
programmes.title: Miffy şi prietenii ei

programmes.description: Grunty este foarte entuziasmată de excursia școlară; nu a mai fost niciodată într-un castel și vrea să plece cât mai repede – dar este mult prea devreme să se întâlnească cu prietenii lor la gară. Miffy face tot posibilul să o liniștească pe Grunty, dar entuziasmul acesteia duce la neîndemânare și haos. Miffy trebuie să găsească o modalitate de a o liniști pe Grunty și de a se asigura că ajung la gară la timp!
programmes.title: Miffy şi prietenii ei

programmes.description: Când Mami o prinde pe Miffy în timp ce mănâncă pe ascuns o gustare, cu toate că nu o vede, Miffy ajunge să creadă că mama ei are puteri magice. Pentru a testa abilitatea mamei sale, Miffy o încurajează pe Snuffy să se ascundă, deoarece mama ei ar trebui să poată găsi câinele fără nicio problemă.
programmes.title: Miffy şi prietenii ei

programmes.description: Miffy și prietenii ei se adună la clubul de dodgeball. Dar Miffy își dă seama că lui Ko nu-i place prea mult jocul. El se întreabă chiar dacă n-ar trebui să părăsească clubul. Pentru Miffy este de neconceput! Așa că îi vine ideea „Clubului de jocuri noi”, pentru a-i permite lui Ko să inventeze un joc nou care s-ar putea să-i placă: „Ko Ball”! Dar, din cauza entuziasmului excesiv, Miffy și prietenii ei nu-l lasă întotdeauna pe Ko să stabilească regulile propriului său joc...
programmes.title: Miffy şi prietenii ei

programmes.title: Miffy şi prietenii ei

programmes.description: Miffy și prietenii ei plantează împreună o grădină a prieteniei, pe care Miffy o adoră până când descoperă că cineva le culege florile. Ce va face Miffy când va afla cine este vinovatul?
programmes.title: Miffy şi prietenii ei

programmes.title: Miffy şi prietenii ei

programmes.description: Miffy îl invită pe Ko să se alăture întâlnirii ei de joacă cu Dan și îi sugerează să joace „Bingo în natură” pentru a-l ajuta pe Ko cu prezentarea lui pentru școală, dar Dan este dezamăgit: el plănuise să joace un alt joc interesant. programmes.description:
În viaţa liniştită a locuitorilor satului oltenesc Sadova îşi fac apariţia Investitorul (Daniel Lazăr) şi Profesoara (Ramona Olteanu), cele două personaje atrăgând atenţia tuturor. Leana (Mugur Mihaescu) şi Urinela (Ani Creţu) vor face tot ce le stă în putinţă pentru a o îndepărta pe frumoasa Profesoară din calea cuceririi inimii Investitorului, cel mai frumos, cel mai deştept şi bogat bărbat din sat.

Axinte (Florin Petrescu) devine bulibaşă iar Lila (Mirela Stoian) este permanent lângă el pentru a-i încurca viaţa. Popa (Cristian Boeriu) se dovedeşte a fi agent CIA sub acoperire, rolul lui real în Sadova fiind de a spiona extratereştrii care ameninţă să atace satul. Serialul Elodia va fi reluat de coloratele personaje din sat, în manieră Vacanţa Mare.

programmes.description: Au filmat in mai multe locuri din tara si au avut parte de un spectacol uluitor al traditiilor, de emotiile coplesitoare ale mirilor si ale familiilor acestora, dar si de distractie pe masura. Au facut tot posibilul pentru a strange zestre cat mai consistenta pentru insuratei si au fost partasii unor momente inedite, atat in spatele cat si in fata camerelor de filmat. Aventurile celor doi indragiti prezentatori, Andreea Mantea si Bursucu, precum si imagini de la cele mai frumoase nunti le veti putea urmari din 26 iunie, in fiecare duminica, de la ora 20:00, la Kanal D.
programmes.title: Se strigă darul

programmes.description:
În viaţa liniştită a locuitorilor satului oltenesc Sadova îşi fac apariţia Investitorul (Daniel Lazăr) şi Profesoara (Ramona Olteanu), cele două personaje atrăgând atenţia tuturor. Leana (Mugur Mihaescu) şi Urinela (Ani Creţu) vor face tot ce le stă în putinţă pentru a o îndepărta pe frumoasa Profesoară din calea cuceririi inimii Investitorului, cel mai frumos, cel mai deştept şi bogat bărbat din sat.

Axinte (Florin Petrescu) devine bulibaşă iar Lila (Mirela Stoian) este permanent lângă el pentru a-i încurca viaţa. Popa (Cristian Boeriu) se dovedeşte a fi agent CIA sub acoperire, rolul lui real în Sadova fiind de a spiona extratereştrii care ameninţă să atace satul. Serialul Elodia va fi reluat de coloratele personaje din sat, în manieră Vacanţa Mare.

Scenariul poartă semnătura Radu Pietreanu care promite că noul produs Vacanţa Mare va creea dependenţă şi că telespectatorii nu se vor putea dezlipi de ecrane şi vor număra minutele până la următorul episod.
programmes.title: Vacanţa Mare: Leana s-a întors!

programmes.description:
Emisiunea “Ochii din umbra” scoate la iveala fata nevăzută a oamenilor și îi arată aşa cum sunt, cu bune şi cu rele. Cu ajutorul unui detectiv particular, vedeta Kanal D supraveghează și investighează îndeaproape o nouă serie de cazuri interesante. "Sunt situații care vă vor ţine cu sufletul la gură, cazuri incitante ce merită urmărite. Mulțumesc dumneavoastră, telespectatorilor noștri fideli, pentru că ne-ați fost alături de la început și datorită vouă  am ajuns la sezonul cinci al emisiunii <<Ochii din umbra>>" – mărturisește Ernest.

De multe ori suntem prieteni cu cineva, pe care îl credem într-un fel, iar într-o situație de criză ne dam seama ca persoana respectiva nu a făcut decât sa ne amăgească. Specialiștii noștri consideră ca e mai bine sa afli adevărul, chiar dacă e dureros, decât să trăiești într-o minciună.

Prin montarea camerelor ascunse supravegherea va putea să scoată la iveala tot felul de secrete bine păzite de unii oameni. Detectivul particular va fi scos în fata și devine el însuși un personaj, care va încerca sa explice oamenilor ce înseamna un filaj și cum se poate face acesta. Evident, unele informații nu vor putea fi făcute publice, din motive obiective.
programmes.title: Ochii din umbră

programmes.description: Emisiunea "În oglindă" își propune să abordeze subiecte tabu, povești de viață marcante, cu o sinceritate debordantă și umanitate, prin vocea prezentatorului și realizatorului emisiunii, Mihai Ghiță, precum și a invitaților acestuia, vedete sau oameni necunoscuți publicului larg. Vor fi aduse în fața publicului subiecte sensibile și vor fi combătute prejudecăți care domină societatea românească și nu numai.

Scenariul poartă semnătura Radu Pietreanu care promite că noul produs Vacanţa Mare va creea dependenţă şi că telespectatorii nu se vor putea dezlipi de ecrane şi vor număra minutele până la următorul episod.
programmes.title: Vacanţa Mare: Leana s-a întors!

programmes.description:
Emisiunea “Ochii din umbra” scoate la iveala fata nevăzută a oamenilor și îi arată aşa cum sunt, cu bune şi cu rele. Cu ajutorul unui detectiv particular, vedeta Kanal D supraveghează și investighează îndeaproape o nouă serie de cazuri interesante. "Sunt situații care vă vor ţine cu sufletul la gură, cazuri incitante ce merită urmărite. Mulțumesc dumneavoastră, telespectatorilor noștri fideli, pentru că ne-ați fost alături de la început și datorită vouă  am ajuns la sezonul cinci al emisiunii <<Ochii din umbra>>" – mărturisește Ernest.

De multe ori suntem prieteni cu cineva, pe care îl credem într-un fel, iar într-o situație de criză ne dam seama ca persoana respectiva nu a făcut decât sa ne amăgească. Specialiștii noștri consideră ca e mai bine sa afli adevărul, chiar dacă e dureros, decât să trăiești într-o minciună.

Prin montarea camerelor ascunse supravegherea va putea să scoată la iveala tot felul de secrete bine păzite de unii oameni. Detectivul particular va fi scos în fata și devine el însuși un personaj, care va încerca sa explice oamenilor ce înseamna un filaj și cum se poate face acesta. Evident, unele informații nu vor putea fi făcute publice, din motive obiective.
programmes.title: Ochii din umbră

programmes.description: Emisiunea "În oglindă" își propune să abordeze subiecte tabu, povești de viață marcante, cu o sinceritate debordantă și umanitate, prin vocea prezentatorului și realizatorului emisiunii, Mihai Ghiță, precum și a invitaților acestuia, vedete sau oameni necunoscuți publicului larg. Vor fi aduse în fața publicului subiecte sensibile și vor fi combătute prejudecăți care domină societatea românească și nu numai.
programmes.title: În oglindă

programmes.description: Au filmat in mai multe locuri din tara si au avut parte de un spectacol uluitor al traditiilor, de emotiile coplesitoare ale mirilor si ale familiilor acestora, dar si de distractie pe masura. Au facut tot posibilul pentru a strange zestre cat mai consistenta pentru insuratei si au fost partasii unor momente inedite, atat in spatele cat si in fata camerelor de filmat. Aventurile celor doi indragiti prezentatori, Andreea Mantea si Bursucu, precum si imagini de la cele mai frumoase nunti le veti putea urmari din 26 iunie, in fiecare duminica, de la ora 20:00, la Kanal D.
programmes.title: Se strigă darul

programmes.description: Chilema este un elefant cu jumătate de trompă, și-a pierdut vârful în lațul unui braconier, menit să prindă antilope cu care să să hrănească. Lațul nu face însă diferența, ceea ce înseamnă că alte animale îi cad pradă adesea, cu rezultate cumplite. Chilema trebuie să se adapteze acum la viața făr cel mai importantă unealtă a elefanților. Ea trebuie să învețe să bea, să mănânce și să facă băi de nămol, pentru a reuși să supraviețuiască. La toate acestea se adaugă provocarea sezonului secetos, dificil, așa că Chilema se străduie să rămână în viață, deși sorții îi sunt împotrivă.

Copacii africani promovează viața și constituie coloana vertebrală a unuia dintre cele mai prețioase ecosisteme de pe Terra.

programmes.description: Pornește în călătorii epice ghidate de forțe lunare. Vezi cum semnale invizibile ghidează balenele și țestoasele de-a lungul rutelor din ocean, străbate continente alături de caprimulgi și vezi gândaci și alte insecte care navighează la lumina lunii.

programmes.description: Aceasta este povestea incredibilă a unui copac vechi de 800 de ani... care poate rezista la cele mai dure condiții... și care este mai îndrăgit de insecte, păsări și animale decât oricare altul... uriașul baobab. programmes.description: Savana africană e un peisaj maiestuos, fie că e vorba de hipopotami care se bat cap în cap, de elefanți hormonali sau lei care se duelează, luptele sălbatice din savană sunt la fel de maiestuoase.
programmes.title: Bătălia animalelor alfa

programmes.description: Misiunea de conservare Lewa se străduie să mute elefanți în teritoriul dintre muntele Kenya și parcul național Samburu. Au înființat și o zonă în care elefanții nu au acces, ca să încerce să revigoreze un ecosistem dezechilibrat. Pentru ambele proiecte folosesc coliere cu monitorizare prin radio, care îi ajută pe conservaționiști să înțeleagă mai bine necesitățile elefanților și să afle dacă se întorc la coridoarele lor naturale.
programmes.title: Jurnalul faunei din Kenya

programmes.description: Veți descoperi cea mai mare insulă vulcanică din lume, un loc izolat, neprietenos, unde aburii țâșnesc, apa explodează și solul se extinde zilnic. Vedeți cum focul și gheața se confruntă într-o luptă care face ca aceasta să fie cea mai puternică insulă de pe Terra, sub aspect geologic.
programmes.title: Priveliști nedescoperite

programmes.description: Faceți turun unei insule de origine vulcanică, dar modelată de gheață. Cu aproximativ 1,5 milioane de ani în urmă, o placă de gheață a coborât dinspre nord și a acoperit insula. În prezent, ghețarii uriași continuă să modeleze dealuri maritime și să fărâmițeze munții.
programmes.title: Priveliști nedescoperite

programmes.description: Pășiți în apele învolburate ale golfului Fundy. Aflați cum acest ecosistem de pe coasta estică susține o mulțime de animale, inclusiv sute de mii de păsări marine, cel mai rapid prădător din lume și un ansamblu complex de nevertebrate.
programmes.title: Priveliști nedescoperite

programmes.description: Călătoriți pe coasta vestică a Marii Britanii, unde cea mai lungă cărare neîntreruptă din lume șerpuiește pe o lungime de peste 1.200 km de peisaj uluitor. Pe coasta maiestuoasă sunt multe animale sălbatice, mistere geologice și secole de istorie umană.
programmes.title: Priveliști nedescoperite

programmes.description: Explorați o insulă înconjurată de maiestuosul ocean Atlantic, bătută de valuri și de ploaie. De la dealurile Moher la Poteca Uriașului, aceste pământuri au fost modelate și remodelate de forța apei și de forțe geologice violente.
programmes.title: Priveliști nedescoperite

programmes.description: Călătoriți pe coasta sălbatică a Pacificului, pe malul vestic al insulei Vancouver, în Columbia Britanică. De la vârfurile ghețarilor din munți la coronamentul singurei păduri tropicale din Canada, natura și spiritul uman coexistă în habitate spectaculoase.
programmes.title: Priveliști nedescoperite

programmes.description: Peste dunele ondulate, pe pajiștile măturate de vânt din sudul deșertului Kalahari, se înalță un arbore Camelthorn superb. Dăinuie aici de două secole. Acest copac nu este însă niciodată singur, căci oferă hrană, adăpost și teren de vânătoare pentru multe animale.
programmes.title: Rădăcini adânci

programmes.description: Descoperă povestea mult îndrăgitului arbore-cu-cârnați. Florile sale pline de nectar, precum și fructele sale în formă de cârnați, ademenesc tot soiul de vietăți, de la insecte la elefanți. Urmărește cum ajunge să se reproducă acest copac datorită animalelor care depind de el.
programmes.title: Rădăcini adânci

programmes.description: Într-o pădure cețoasă din Africa de Sud se găsește un afrocarp în vârstă de 600 de ani. Având 40 de metri, se înalță deasupra coronamentului și este unul dintre ultimii rămași din specia sa. Urmărește-i povestea captivantă și unică precum ecosistemul aflat pe ramurile sale.
programmes.title: Rădăcini adânci

programmes.description: Bătălia supremă pentru dominație - oamenii de știință încearcă să aleagă masculul alfa dintr-o haită de peste 100 de rechini albi de pe coasta Noii Zeelande. Minunați-vă de viteza, abilitățile de vânătoare și curajul liderului haitei.
programmes.title: Rechinul-șef

programmes.description: Pornim într-o periculoasă misiune de marcare a rechinilor în sudul Australiei, pentru a afla ce mănâncă și de ce se adună în anumite locuri pentru hrănire. Apoi urmărim spre nord rechini-tigru, taur și ciocan, atașând unuia o cameră de luat vederi.
programmes.title: Autostrada rechinilor

programmes.description: Să urmărim o femelă ce va avea pui de-a lungul Marii Bariere de Corali, sperând că îi va conduce pe cercetători la destinația sa ascunsă. Apoi, de-a lungul coastei de sud, semne specifice ar putea indica o femelă timidă, în căutarea unui partener.
programmes.title: Autostrada rechinilor

programmes.description: Echipa din nord atașează un dispozitiv de urmărire unui rechin-taur pentru a-i cunoaște activitățile de după apus. După aceea, plonjăm 80 de metri cu echipa din sud, care speră să poată fixa un dispozitiv GPS pe o femelă de mare alb.
programmes.title: Autostrada rechinilor

programmes.description: Evaluați ierarhiile din grupurile de rechini împreună cu echipa din nord care studiază învățarea talentelor sociale și de supraviețuire la rechinii tineri. Urmăriți cu echipa din sud rechinul-tigru în manifestarea sa cea mai discretă: în împerechere.
programmes.title: Autostrada rechinilor

programmes.description: Călătoriți până la capătul traseelor rechinilor Australiei. Aflați dacă insula Greenly din sud este o escală în migrația marilor rechini albi, apoi căutați dovada unei legături genetice între rechinii-taur din nord și verii lor din climate mai reci.
programmes.title: Autostrada rechinilor

programmes.description: Urmăriți cum echipa din sud testează noi tehnologii ce ar putea reduce numărul atacurilor într-un popular loc de scufundări. Apoi capturați și marcați rechini-taur cu echipa din nord, pentru ca înotătorii să evite rechinii în perioada de înmulțire.
programmes.title: Autostrada rechinilor

programmes.description: Călătoriți până la capătul traseelor rechinilor Australiei. Aflați dacă insula Greenly din sud este o escală în migrația marilor rechini albi, apoi căutați dovada unei legături genetice între rechinii-taur din nord și verii lor din climate mai reci.
programmes.title: Autostrada rechinilor

programmes.description: Urmăriți cum echipa din sud testează noi tehnologii ce ar putea reduce numărul atacurilor într-un popular loc de scufundări. Apoi capturați și marcați rechini-taur cu echipa din nord, pentru ca înotătorii să evite rechinii în perioada de înmulțire.
programmes.title: Autostrada rechinilor

programmes.description: O emisiune care va avea ca invitați medici cunoscuți care ne vor învăța cum să ne ferim de anumite boli, unde vor fi expuse particularitățile acestor boli, dar și discuții despre tipuri de patologii. Emisiunea TeleMedika are un scop educativ pentru a încerca să învețe telespectatorul să prevină apariția diverselor afecțiuni. Formatul permite interacţiunea directă între medicii invitaţi şi telespectatori prin intermediul telefonului şi a reţelelor sociale.
programmes.title: Telemedika

programmes.description: Academia de Sănătate este un show informativ bazat, în mare parte, pe interviuri cu renumiți profesori universitari din domeniul medical. Subiectele emisiunii sunt de actualitate şi sunt menite să ridice misterul asupra unor boli cu notorietate și să facă lumină în ceea ce privește actul medical de calitate. Domeniul medical este unul vast din toate punctele de vedere şi de aceea considerăm că introducerea în grila de programe a emisiunilor de acest tip este una benefică pentru telespectatori. În această emisiune telespectatorii au posibilitatea să fie informaţi direct de la cei ce sunt responsabili de actul medical. Formatl show-ului va încuraja dezbaterile, iar finalul va fi uşor de comunicat.
programmes.title: Academia de sănătate

programmes.description: Simultaneously painter and diplomat, Peter Paul Rubens, (1577-1640) was an essential personality in Europe’s 17th century artistic scene. He painted vast compositions for princely families of the time like the Marie de Medici cycle now housed in the Louvre Museum. He also personified the baroque vein in Northern Europe, developing a style of perpetual movement with luminous coloured strokes as in the “Rape of the Daughters of Leucippus” exhibited in Munich.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

Leah and the third year students will pass an exam for their Bachelor of Photography in front of the jury. Will Leah obtain her degree ? All the students are here to support her.
programmes.title: When I grow up I'll be a photographer

programmes.description: In this episode, the two candidates Sylvain Paulet and Martial Hadmar will have one hour to confront each other on an imposed theme. Today the theme is complicated because they will have to photograph the Astria waste recycling plant in Bordeaux and make it look good.

However, the author of the novel "Du côté de chez Swann", never saw the gardens. This shows the imagination that these gardens unfold, even though they were skilfully designed for more than 40 years by the master of the place, Claude Monet.

programmes.description: An art genre which has existed since antiquity, still-lifes became popular again in 17th century European painting. Depicting inanimate objects, compositions might be confined to a meal on a table, as in Lubin’s frugal “Still-Life with Water Biscuits”, or portray hunted animals as in the “Still-Life with Pheasant” by Jean-Baptiste Oudry. You will also find famous still-lifes by Chardin, Cézanne and Van Gogh.\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: From the birth of a unique voice in the artworld of the sixties, to worldwide consecration in the 90’s and 2000’s… From the “Ecole des Beaux Arts” in Paris to the Grand Prize of Rome, going all the way through Italy’s Villa Medicis and the Hermitage Museum in Saint Petersburg… André Brasilier is a self-defined “transfigurative” French painter, seeking harmony between plastic construction and emotion, and drawing his inspiration from life itself. As he is nearing his 100th birthday, this exclusive documentary invites you to step through a retrospective celebrating 70 years of a unique career, which is held at the Hangaram Design Museum of Seoul, South Korea.
programmes.title: André Brasilier - Where Dreams come from

programmes.description: In this episode, we'll talk with Emmanuel Bastien, photographer and videographer. For the past 20 years, he has shot documentaries, commercials, fashion and news for major networks. During his lifetime, he has witnessed political instability and poverty in India, Cambodia and Mali, which has led him to focus on social issues and personal struggles.
programmes.title: The decisive moment

programmes.description: Gregor Hildebrandt has chosen to set up his workshop in the Wedding district of Berlin. The artist creates paintings and installations from pre-recorded magnetic sound tapes. It is a mise en abîme in works where the music becomes inaudible. The canvas preciously keeps in it the sounds and the notes which exist only in the head of the spectator and that of the artist.
programmes.title: Artist's Workshop

programmes.description: In 2008, the chance discovery in the South of Italy of an ancient portrait with strangely familiar features takes the art world by storm. Could this be an unknown self-portrait by Leonardo da Vinci? Controversy erupts among the experts. The implications of such a discovery have far-reaching consequences for our understanding of the work of this great Renaissance master.
programmes.title: Leonardo: The Mystery of the lost portrait

programmes.description: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "The Courtauld Collection: The Party of Impressionism" at the Louis Vuitton Foundation in Paris. We will present some of the masterpieces from the collection of Samuel Courtauld, English industrialist, art collector and founder of the Courtauld Institute of Art and the Courtauld Gallery in London. During this visit you will see works such as "A Bar at the Folies Bergères" by Edouard Manet or "Lake Annecy" by Cézanne.

programmes.description: MisterPee was born in 1975 in Paris. Immersed from a very young age in the world of images, notably thanks to his photographer father, he took his first artistic steps on the walls of the wastelands of his neighborhood.

He started with reportage, quickly moved on to portraits, and thanks to a French newspaper, he was able to train through press commissions. For the past fifteen years, he has taken a more personal approach to his work, focusing on the individual.

To top it off, he commissioned James Turrell to create an original work on the hillside.

You will be able to discover the artist, he was at the same time a painter, a ceramist, a sculptor, a draughtsman, a creator of tapestries and stained glass. Through the various periods leading him from post impressionism to pop art through cubism, the artist asserts himself as one of the most prolific and original artists of the 20th century.

programmes.description: Established as a pictorial genre in its own right during the Renaissance, the female nude became one of the most important subjects in European painting. Under pretexts both mythological (Titian’s “Venus of Urbino”) and biblical (Rembrandt’s “Bathsheba at her Bath”) or Oriental (Ingres’“Great Odalisque”), the female body was unveiled. These pretexts vanish with Manet’s “Olympia”, a simple portrayal of a contemporary woman naked, which resulted in scandal.\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: In this episode, we meet the famous German celebrity photographer, Martin Schoeller. He will discuss his characteristic style in photography: a similar treatment of all subjects photographed, whether they are famous or anonymous.
programmes.title: The decisive moment

programmes.description: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibitions on human rights at the Musée de l'Homme in Paris. Nine street artists invaded the walls of the atrium to illustrate articles of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. It is a unique exhibition because the artists came on site and realized their works in front of the public. Let's discover these engaged and unconventional artistic creations.
programmes.title: Private Tour

programmes.description: The man with the long greying beard who we find in this self-portrait is the painter Camille Pissarro (1830-1903). A keen follower of the Impressionist movement, the artist specialised in landscapes around Paris, often painted in winter, such as the “Chestnut Tress at Louveciennes” or the urban landscapes of Montmartre. Towards the end of his life, his painting technique changed and he turned towards Neo-Impressionism, for example in the “Seine River and Louvre Palace”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

French painting of the 18th century, in Gallant and Rococo vein, is particularly well represented, including none other than the masterpiece of licentious painting: “The Swing” by Fragonard.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

He is a visual artist who loves the metamorphoses that are imprinted in his sculptures with reversible materials. Known for having transformed the Palais Royal metro station into a "kiosk for night owls", the artist favors materials with poetic and sensitive properties.

programmes.description: Caspar David Friedrich (1774-1840) is a German Romantic painter who concentrated mainly on landscape art, which he rendered in minute detail. He was rediscovered at the end of the 19th century. A melancholy character, he peopled his canvases with human figures seen from behind, contemplating the enormity of nature, for example in his famous “The Wanderer above the Mists” in Hamburg or the “Chalk Cliffs on Rügen”. Notice his superb landscapes with their twilight tones.\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: From the first Buddhas found in Afghanistan to the mysterious treasures of Angkor, from the most beautiful Japanese prints to the fine arts of Chinese ceramics, the National Museum of Asian Arts - Guimet offers as many possibilities as possible of course meditative, aesthetic, or exploratory at the heart of Asian history. True to wish of its founder Emile Guimet, the museum brings together today the largest collection of Asian art in Europe.

In “Netherlandish Proverbs”, he wittily transcribes dozens of popular sayings. Admire also his incomplete “Tower of Babel”, a theme which Bruegel made into his own speciality.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

The creative and familiar universe of Renoir, one of the most striking French artists in the history of art is displayed in a remarkable setting with century-old olive trees and citrus trees, with a panorama that extends to the Cap d'Antibes.

Powerful and complex, Jérôme Zonder's art captivates by its technical prowess and questions our relationship to violence.

programmes.description: While Europe and the United States dominate the art scene after World War II, Mark Rothko and Hans Hartung forged a discreet, friendly and very fertile bond. This documentary introduces the discovery of this little known and fascinating complicity between both artists. On the one hand, Mark Rothko, "the most violent of American painters" in his own words; on the other, Hans Hartung, a brilliant experimenter and "boxer" in front of the canvas. From the moment they met in 1950 in Hans Hartung's studio, there was a collaboration between them that resulted in huge, metaphysical and cataclysmic paintings. Then, Rothko gave a "lesson" to his European colleague, Hartung visited and paid homage to his elder and then mourned his suicide from Antibes, where he had a huge villa-studio built and kept the secrets of his relationship. This Rothko-Hartung encounter is an unprecedented and yet essential subject to understand a part of 20th century art.
programmes.title: Rothko – Hartung: Colors and Cataclysms

programmes.description: While Europe and the United States dominate the art scene after World War II, Mark Rothko and Hans Hartung forged a discreet, friendly and very fertile bond. This documentary introduces the discovery of this little known and fascinating complicity between both artists. On the one hand, Mark Rothko, "the most violent of American painters" in his own words; on the other, Hans Hartung, a brilliant experimenter and "boxer" in front of the canvas. From the moment they met in 1950 in Hans Hartung's studio, there was a collaboration between them that resulted in huge, metaphysical and cataclysmic paintings. Then, Rothko gave a "lesson" to his European colleague, Hartung visited and paid homage to his elder and then mourned his suicide from Antibes, where he had a huge villa-studio built and kept the secrets of his relationship. This Rothko-Hartung encounter is an unprecedented and yet essential subject to understand a part of 20th century art.
programmes.title: Rothko – Hartung: Colors and Cataclysms

programmes.description: Established as a pictorial genre in its own right during the Renaissance, the female nude became one of the most important subjects in European painting. Under pretexts both mythological (Titian’s “Venus of Urbino”) and biblical (Rembrandt’s “Bathsheba at her Bath”) or Oriental (Ingres’“Great Odalisque”), the female body was unveiled. These pretexts vanish with Manet’s “Olympia”, a simple portrayal of a contemporary woman naked, which resulted in scandal.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

A melancholy character, he peopled his canvases with human figures seen from behind, contemplating the enormity of nature, for example in his famous “The Wanderer above the Mists” in Hamburg or the “Chalk Cliffs on Rügen”. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

You will find one of the copies of Leda and the Swan by da Vinci as well as Caravaggio’s David.  Enjoy your visit!

programmes.description: Richard Rogers and Renzo Piano, to meet the challenge posed to the architects, designed a building in the form of a giant Meccano, which immediately stood out in the Parisian architectural landscape. The architectural project, as described in the competition rules, had to meet the requirements of multidisciplinarity, free movement and open exhibition spaces. This competition was won by two young architects, the Italian Renzo Piano and the Briton Richard Rogers, by proposing a building in the spirit of libertarian architecture characteristic of the 1960s. The load-bearing structure and circulation, the escalator caterpillar for example, are rejected outside, leaving all the space for museum and activity spaces. Moored to the outside on the east façade, and used as cladding for the structure, the technical ducts stand out in four colors: blue for air, green for fluids, yellow for electrical ducts and red for circulation. The transparency of the main facade to the west allows observation.
programmes.title: Architectures

programmes.description: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era.  What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: No artist captured the essence and charm of Venice better than Giovanni Antonio Canal, better known as Canaletto. This remarkable collection of over 200 paintings, drawings and etchings allows us to discover Canaletto's artistic talent, his contemporaries and the city he reproduced with genius. The film also opens the doors of two official royal residences, Buckingham Palace and Windsor Castle, to reveal more about the artist and Joseph Smith, the man who introduced Canaletto to Britain.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description:
Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.

It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.

Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.

The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: William Turner is known throughout the world as one of the best landscape painters of the English school. He strived to represent landscapes in what was qualified as a romantic style. As his artistic creations progressed, which are revealed here, Turner gave himself over to greater fantasy and boldness in his treatment of colour and light, verging on the imaginary in such a way as to be considered today as one of the precursors of impressionism. Discover his masterpiece exposed at the National Gallery such as " The Fighting Temeraire " or at the Boston Museum of Fine arts with " The Négrier ".\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: Through some works of Fragonard, Boucher, Watteau (among others), here is the rococo current whose works go back to the end of the XVIIIth century. The theme of the fêtes galantes also evokes the fact that the setbacks of love are inseparable from its pleasures.
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!
programmes.title: My little Museum

programmes.description:
A celebrity couple Road Trip – award winning journalists John Stapleton and Lynn Faulds Wood.
 
Joining them on this jolly jaunt are Thomas Plant and Margie Cooper. With £400 in their pockets the teams kick off in Wrightington, Lancashire and head to Stockport for auction.  

Lynn and Thomas find themselves literally knee deep in antiques while hunting for old biscuit tins while Margie tries to convince John some rare lamps will make a profit. 

Also John learns how an American revolutionised British public transport and Lynn sees why snakes are milked in Liverpool.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: For almost 500 years, a large painting showing two young women at a fountain has  been seen as an absolute hymn to beauty and love, executed by the young Titian who  had set out to conquer the Venetian art scene. It is a solemn, luminous song, looking onto a bright, harmonious universe; it is the first true masterpiece of the twenty-five-year-old painter who knowingly started revolutionizing  the history of painting.  As one of his contemporaries said, Titian “walks hand in hand with nature; all of his figures are alive, move, and their flesh  quivers.” After changing hands several times among different Venetian collections, it was finally purchased by Cardinal Scipione Borghese in 1608  for the Roman collection to which it still belongs today. The painting soon lost all ties with the person who commissioned it, and came to be understood as a broad, universal allegory of love, of two possible forms of love; the “sacred” and the “profane”.
programmes.title: Masterpieces Unveiled

programmes.description: The Garden Of Earthly Delights: how did this five-panel triptych by Jeroen Anthoniszoon van Aken, known as Hieronymus Bosch, come to be created, when was  it painted, what was it used for, and what does it really represent? No one knows; for most of bosch’s works no documents or precise information about buyers exist.  even the dating itself is complicated. Historians, archivists, and art critics have tried everything.  A veil of mystery envelops his entire artistic production, giving rise to the most varied rumours but for now searching for clues in the local traditions, in the writings in latin, french, german and dutch, searching for possible iconographic precedents and parallels, peering into the murky mirror of magical rites and heresies, delving into alchemy treatises, and pulling out from the fog of history figures who had practically  been forgotten. The search goes on, but for the time being we have no first-hand information. For almost all of bosch’s works, no conclusive docu.
programmes.title: Masterpieces Unveiled

programmes.description: The image of the wealthy merchant from Lucca Giovanni Arnolfini shown together with  his wife in the intimacy of their comfortable home in Bruges has always been  considered the brilliant figurative proof of the commercial and artistic relations between Italy and Flanders in the 15th century.  However, there has been a certain amount of doubtful attention devoted to the figures for some time; in fact, the hypothesis that one of the maximum masterpieces of portraiture of all times may not depict the Arnolfinis at all, but the van Eycks, is not entirely new. It had already been cautiously suggested by the Director of London’s  National Gallery over a century and a half ago, when the painting was purchased by the great museum, but the idea was soon cast aside by the objections of specialists. Other doubts about the couple’s identity have cropped up a number of times, juggled back and forth amongst the abundant historic information on the painting, archival research, and allegorical theori.
programmes.title: Masterpieces Unveiled

programmes.description: For us today the Montefeltro Altarpiece, preserved in the Brera Art Gallery in Milan, is  the “Altarpiece by Piero” par excellence.  It is surprising to learn however, that until the late 1800s no one would ever have dreamed of attributing this impressive masterpiece to the hand of Piero della Francesca. For long centuries it was a deeply-rooted belief that the painter of the work was a certain Bartolomeo Corradini, a friar-painter known by the funny nickname of Fra Carnevale. It is in this guise that the Montefeltro Altarpiece came to Brera in 1811 and all the catalogues of the Milan Art Gallery repeated Fra Carnevale’s name until the end of that century. Piero della Francesca was simply forgotten... His name and his works ended up literally in the dust of oblivion until they disappeared from the horizon of history... His critical resurrection happened however, in the early 1900s, the century in which the Master painter wielded a powerful influence on the art of the first decades….
programmes.title: Masterpieces Unveiled

This exhibition tries to represent the works of the artist Wim Delvoye as well as possible. You will be able to observe emblematic works of the artist such as "the tattooed pig".
programmes.title: Private Tour

It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Lucian Freud, one of the most famous British painters of our time, is also one of the few twentieth-century artists to have portrayed himself so consistently in self-portraiture. His self-portraits provide a fascinating insight into both his personality and his development as a painter, from his first portrait in 1939 to his last. Through fascinating interviews with former models, friends and leading experts, this intensely captivating documentary reveals the work of a master who represents a compelling study of the dynamics of aging and the process of self-representation.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programmes.description:
Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. 

Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. 

An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description:
Two legends of British comedy, Ronni Ancona and Jan Ravens are joined on this Road Trip by antiquers Phil Serrell and James Braxton. Starting in the North Yorkshire town of Redcar they’ll head for auction in Stockport in Cheshire. 

Jan gets rather carried away and spends every single penny of her entire budget. While Ronni gets a kick out of a very kitsch glass boot. 

A quick detour sees Jan find out why Hartlepudlians thought a monkey was a Frenchman and Ronni is left open mouthed when Braxton takes off his clothes. Crikey!
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: Discover the work of Matisse through the exhibitions at Tate Modern in London and MoMA in New York (2014) and enjoy the original performance of Royal Ballet star dancer Zenaida Yanowsky, who interprets the colors and dynamism of Matisse's painting to the jazz music of Courtney Pine. Punctuated by interviews with experts and rare archival footage of Matisse at work, this documentary will provide a special insight into the last chapter of the painter's career.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Gouzous are small anthropomorphic characters that frequently appear as collages or more often as graffiti in the urban space of Reunion Island, but also in other countries. The author is the French graffiti artist Jace, originally from Le Havre, who lives and works in La Réunion.
programmes.title: Completely Gouzou

programmes.description: This documentary travels to France to question the contours of Raw Art. Savine Faupin, curator of the department Art Brut at LAM, Matthew Morin, connoisseur and collector Christian Berst, owner of the eponymous gallery: each character tries to put his own definition of an art difficult to grasp. Indeed, Raw Art is constantly renewing itself, it is not limited by time or by the style and remains foremost vector emotional message.
programmes.title: Raw Art: When one looks, one finds it!

programmes.description: The official and conventionné art (including condominiums) painted walls of Lyon hides its origins: the art of graffiti wild. It was a great development in 1968, when the premises of the School of Fine Arts, then located on the slopes of the Croix Rousse, has formed a generation of graffiti artists, crossing experiences and printing silk with the revolutionary tradition of the Croix-Rousse. This tradition is now focused on its slopes (part of the Croix-Rousse between northern place Tereaux and southern boulevard Croix Rousse), plateau (north of the boulevard) is now fully bobo. Then graffiti art cross-Roussien has experienced a revival in the birth of hip-hop and graffiti in New York and his arrival in France. Today, this area of ​​the slopes of the Croix-Rousse remains by far the most intense instead of street art in Lyon. With the worst and the best.
programmes.title: Street Art Lyon, viewpoints

programmes.description: Photographer Bruno Dewaele asks Antoine Agoudjian for several large silver prints as he prepares an exhibition. They have been working closely together for 20 years, developing a strong alchemy. Let’s witness the journey from negative film to print photography.
programmes.title: Printing photography

programmes.description: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programmes.description: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: Adalberto Libera was one of the most important figures in twentieth-century architecture, and also one of the most emblematic: he was both a pioneer of architectural modernity and a convinced Fascist, innovative architect and architect of the regime. Unlike the Nazis, Mussolini allied himself with the modern movement, which became the official architectural style of Fascism. In 1937, the regime launched one of its most ambitious projects: the E 42. The aim was to create a new monumental city for the 1942 International Exhibition, embodying the new Imperial Rome.
programmes.title: Architectures

programmes.description: In this episode, we will meet the artist Richard Texier. He is now considered one of the best living artists of his generation. His work is based on the Pantheo Vortex, an artistic exploration of the mystery and beauty of the world. His works can be found in numerous public and private collections, both in France and abroad.
programmes.title: Artist's Workshop

programmes.description: In this episode, we will meet the artist Erik Desmazières. He is one of the most famous printmakers in France, and is exhibited around the world. He has brought to this discipline, a little outdated, a form of modernity, thanks to his fantastic landscapes soaked in science-fiction, immediately noticed by the collectors. Member of the French Academy of Fine Arts since 2008, Erik Desmazières has turned in recent years to realistic landscapes.
programmes.title: Artist's Workshop

programmes.description:
Today we’re in the North East of England with top wheelchair paralympians Tanni Grey-Thompson and Jade Jones. Tanni has a record haul of medals and records, while her promising young protégé Jade is just starting out on her athletics career.  

In the company of experts Phil Serrell and David Harper, the Baroness from County Durham and Middlesbrough’s Jade will be on the lookout for antiques to take to auction in Harrogate.  

Tanni also tries her hand at traditional glass making and Jade learns about the man who was a design champion of the region.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: Juan Jose Cambre chose the trendy neighborhood of Palermo in Buenos Aires to install his studio. He practices a colorful art. Obsessed with the idea of representation, Juan Jose Cambre marks his painting by a desire for simplification that leads him to the purification of all artifice to keep only the essence of the color.

You will be able to appreciate the simplicity of his figures, the restraint in his lines and colours, especially when you admire “The Woman with the Blue Eyes” or the “Portrait of Anna Zborowska”.  Enjoy your visit!

Close to the Medici family, he is renowned and admired for his portraits and his female nudes inspired by Greek mythology, such as the majestic “Birth of Venus”, exhibited in the Uffizi Gallery in Florence, and also presented to you here.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programmes.description:
The Villa Dall’Ava, designed by Rem Koolhaas in 1991, is an iconic project located on the heights of Saint-Cloud, near Paris. This house is distinguished by its bold architecture and geometric forms that challenge the traditional conventions of a typical villa. The structure consists of shifted volumes, with two apartment boxes appearing to float above the pool, creating an impression of lightness.

Koolhaas faced significant technical and aesthetic challenges during the design of the villa. On one hand, he dealt with opposition from neighbors concerned about the visual and structural impact of the house on the surrounding landscape. On the other hand, he had to devise ingenious solutions to support the weight of the boxes and the pool, which holds 65 tons of water. The villa incorporates carefully planned internal supports and a drainage system to ensure the stability of the structure.

In addition to these challenges, Villa Dall’Ava serves as a reflection on modern living and the rel.
programmes.title: Architectures

This film reveals intimate, previously unseen interviews and focuses on two successful exhibitions that took place in 2012 and 2016 at the Royal Academy of Arts in London.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: A remarkable event occurred at London’s National Gallery when the largest ever collection of Leonardo’s surviving paintings was assembled in a unique exhibition: Leonardo da Vinci: Painter at the Court of Milan. \r\nLeonardo is recognised as perhaps the greatest painter and sculptor of all time but there was no end to his talents.  This film tells his life story and expands on Leonardo the visionary and inventor from the place where he lived out his final years at Château du Clos Lucé in France, concluding that Leonardo da Vinci was perhaps the very embodiment of the spirit of the Renaissance.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Eugène Delacroix is considered as the leader of French Romanticism, a simultaneously passionate, dramatic and tormented artistic movement, which emerged at the beginning of the 19th century. However, more than a movement, it is a whole creative and captivating artistic development, which is on offer here, through the study of 10 of the artist’s major works. He was to have a notable influence on all modern artistic movements, which after him, were to explore the power of colour and light. Discover " Liberty leading the people " or " The death of Sardanapalus " exposed at the Louvre.\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!
programmes.title: My little Museum

programmes.description:
It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London.  

There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. 

David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.
programmes.title: Stolen Treasures

programmes.description: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s "The Boy with a Soap Bubble" disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.
programmes.title: Stolen Treasures

programmes.description: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….
programmes.title: Stolen Treasures

programmes.description: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.\r\nWhat led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: The Sunflowers are among Van Gogh's most famous paintings. The Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam has dedicated an exhibition to these works and Exhibition on screen, which was given exclusive access to the event, guides us through the exhibition to investigate the mysteries surrounding these paintings. The film also takes us to Tokyo, Philadelphia, London and Munich to follow the 5 main works in the exhibition.

While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.\r\nAnd, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

Pop Icon and actress Claire Grogan is reunited with fellow Glaswegian, Taggart actor Alex Norton as they battle it out in the search for profitable antiques. Anita Manning and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to lend their expertise. 

Anita and Alex find themselves on an Antiques ‘Boat’ Trip as they reminisce about childhood trips down the Clyde. While Claire and Paul see firsthand what Stirling castle would’ve looked like in the 16th century. 

The result of the auction in Ayr all rests on a naked lady.

The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

In an exhibition entitled ‘Vermeer and Music: The Art of Love and Leisure’, The National Gallery has chosen to focus on Vermeer’s relationship with music. It is one of the most popular themes of Dutch painting and reveals an enormous amount about this most fascinating of artists.

programmes.description: Who was Frida Kahlo? Journey into the life of a true icon, discover her art and the truth behind her often turbulent life. The combination of interviews, commentary and a detailed exploration of Kahlo's art offers a treasure trove of color and a feast of vitality. This intimate, personal documentary provides privileged access to her works, and sheds light on her feverish creativity, resilience and unparalleled thirst for life.

programmes.description: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

He is considered to be the founder of western portraiture and practised this art meticulously.  Look closely at the famous “Arnolfini Portrait” exposed at the National Gallery, where the circular mirror at the back of the room shows the artist’s reflection, or the beautiful “Virgin of Chancellor Rolin” exposed at the Louvre, a picture in which three arches open onto a river landscape.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programmes.description: In 1050, one of the first major pilgrimage churches in the Western world was built at Conques, in the middle of the wild Aveyron landscape. This was the birth of "Romanesque" architecture. The abbey church - i.e., a church belonging to an abbey - at Conques is one of the most important structures built in 11th-century France. Its coherence, its location - a small village in the Rouergue region, far from the main medieval traffic routes - its innovative aspect, its state of preservation and the fact that the relics for which it was built are still in situ, make the church at Conques the best work of art for approaching Romanesque architecture in France. In other words, to try and understand how architecture was made at that time in our history, and to dismantle not only the building itself, but also a number of preconceived ideas about Romanesque art, starting with its very name, which is an intellectual construct of the 19th century, or to put it another way: those who built Conques.
programmes.title: Architectures

His painting is made of liberties : it speaks about society, violence, sexuality, people's suffering, their small happiness, their smallness, their greatness... He is inspired by rock music, of which he is a great fan, popular images from childhood books, schoolbooks, and everything that makes a popular culture accessible to all.

This was an opportunity to analyze Cézanne's work with the help of international experts and to tour the rooms of the National Portrait Gallery in London and the National Gallery of Art in Washington.

programmes.description: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?\r\nThis new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: Discover or rediscover Chaim Soutine's masterpieces, each one more surprising than the last.
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!
programmes.title: My little Museum

programmes.description:
Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. 

Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. 

An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”\r\nDiscover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: The Kiss by Gustav Klimt is one of the most recognised and reproduced paintings in the world. It is perhaps the most popular poster on student dorm walls from Beijing to Boston. Painted in Vienna around 1908, the evocative image of an unknown embracing couple has captivated viewers with its mystery, sensuality and dazzling materials ever since it was created. But just what lies behind the appeal of the painting – and just who was the artist that created it? Delving into the details of real gold, decorative designs, symbolism and simmering erotica, a close study of the painting takes us to the remarkable turn of the century Vienna when a new world was battling with the old.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Architects furniture, 1960-2020" at the Cité de l'Architecture et du Patrimoine in Paris. Why do architects still design furniture today, while designers have taken over the real estate market, lighting...? You will have the answer in this private tour and you will discover furniture of architects such as Nemo.
programmes.title: Private Tour

programmes.description: This eagerly-awaited exhibition at the Royal Academy of Arts was the first-ever retrospective devoted to the portraiture of Édouard Manet. Covering the entire career of this enigmatic and sometimes controversial artist, the exhibition brought together works from Europe, Asia and the United States. Manet's portraiture has never been the subject of an exhibition, although it represents around half of his artistic output. He painted his family, friends and the literary, political and artistic figures of the day, bringing to life not only his subjects but also Parisian society.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Wilhelm Hansen was a visionary businessman who lived in Denmark in the 19th century. He was one of the few collectors to take an interest in the Impressionist painters, at a time when they were attacked and denigrated. The film takes us to Hansen's summer home on the outskirts of Copenhagen, and to the extraordinary exhibition of his collection at London's Royal Academy.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.
programmes.title: Graffiti World

programmes.description: Legends of stage and screen, Charles Dance and Geraldine James join antiques experts Natasha Raskin and Will Axon on this Road Trip romp around Wiltshire. \r\nCharles finds a pair of Edwardian silver vases he hopes will prove profitable at an auction in Essex. Geraldine, however, bumps into a chap in the street with a 19th Century French Empire secretaire. It costs her a small fortune – will the gamble pay off? \r\nA diversion from the shops sees Charles end up in the cockpit of a very old helicopter while Geraldine learns how a small part of Swindon dating back 170 years influenced the creation of the modern NHS.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: Top presenting pals Nicki Chapman and Jules Hudson escape to the country to find antiques with Natasha Raskin and Phillip Serrell. It becomes girls versus boys, both teams with £400 in their pockets. Kicking off from Wormsley in Herefordshire they Road Trip into Wales and Oxfordshire, before finally finishing in North Finchley, in London for an auction.\r\n\r\nAlong the way the girls meet a clog maker who carves shoes by hand.  While the boys head to the Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum to hear about the regiment’s involvement at Gallipoli.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description:
A celebrity couple Road Trip – award winning journalists John Stapleton and Lynn Faulds Wood.
 
Joining them on this jolly jaunt are Thomas Plant and Margie Cooper. With £400 in their pockets the teams kick off in Wrightington, Lancashire and head to Stockport for auction.  

Lynn and Thomas find themselves literally knee deep in antiques while hunting for old biscuit tins while Margie tries to convince John some rare lamps will make a profit. 

Also John learns how an American revolutionised British public transport and Lynn sees why snakes are milked in Liverpool.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description:
Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country.  Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton.  

But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine?  

Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description:
TV chefs Aldo Zilli and Ching He-Huang do battle on this Road Trip around South Eastern England, aided by experts Natasha Raskin and Paul Laidlaw. 

Aldo plumps for a gold ring despite expert advice while Ching hopes antiques with an eastern origin will far well at auction in north London.

Aldo stops off to meet a 200 year old named ‘Jill’ to hear how she supplied locals with flour. And animal lover Ching learns how one man faced ridicule and ruin while trying to protect cattle in the 19th century.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description:
Two legends of British comedy, Ronni Ancona and Jan Ravens are joined on this Road Trip by antiquers Phil Serrell and James Braxton. Starting in the North Yorkshire town of Redcar they’ll head for auction in Stockport in Cheshire. 

Jan gets rather carried away and spends every single penny of her entire budget. While Ronni gets a kick out of a very kitsch glass boot. 

A quick detour sees Jan find out why Hartlepudlians thought a monkey was a Frenchman and Ronni is left open mouthed when Braxton takes off his clothes. Crikey!
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description:
Pop Icon and actress Claire Grogan is reunited with fellow Glaswegian, Taggart actor Alex Norton as they battle it out in the search for profitable antiques. Anita Manning and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to lend their expertise. 

Anita and Alex find themselves on an Antiques ‘Boat’ Trip as they reminisce about childhood trips down the Clyde. While Claire and Paul see firsthand what Stirling castle would’ve looked like in the 16th century. 

The result of the auction in Ayr all rests on a naked lady.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: She was born in 1935 in a small village in the north of France, in Quiévy, and moved permanently to Paris in the 1960s. Working since 1972 in her studio in the 15th arrondissement, Geneviève Claisse has become one of the leading exponents of geometric abstraction in France.
programmes.title: Artist's Workshop

programmes.description:
It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London.  

There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. 

David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: Today, we give you an appointment under the sun of Marseille where two candidates will compete to determine who will be the best photographer. The two candidates are Clotilde Penet and Natalie Kovachevski, and they will have one hour to take the best photograph on the imposed theme of art and rock.
programmes.title: Photo Contest

He became a ceramist. The young artist evokes the earth within him with the magic of his hands and composes sculptural creations awakened by a vital spirit.
